Founded in 2011, we offer our audience everything from breaking news to reviews to award-winning features and investigations, on our site, in video, and in podcasts. 2026-11-14T15:22:41+00:00 https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/01/verge-rss-large_80b47e.png?w=150&h=150&crop=1 Sheena Vasani https://www.theverge.com/?p=1032500 2026-11-14T09:21:53-05:00 2026-11-14T10:00:00-05:00 Black Friday has become a shopping season of its own, with retailers once again offering discounts well ahead of the actual shopping holiday. We’ve already rounded up some of the best early Black Friday deals we’ve come across, but if you’re looking to save on outdoor gear or pick up something for an upcoming trip, REI’s annual Holiday Sale , which runs through November 23rd, is worth checking out. As usual, the outdoor retailer is offering discounts on everything from smartwatches to camping equipment. In some cases, we’re seeing some of the lowest prices we’ve seen on our favorite wearables, including Garmin’s Forerunner 570 , while gadgets like the InReach Mini 3 are also receiving sizable discounts. REI members can also use promo code HOLIDAY2026 to save 20 percent on one full-price item, plus an additional 20 percent on one REI Outlet item. To save you time, we’ve sifted through the deluge of discounts to find an assortment of deals we recommend here at The Verge . We’ve also noted when competing retailers are offering lower prices on the same items, so you can be sure you’re getting the best deal possible. Smartwatches and fitness tech Garmin Forerunner 570 Garmin’s Forerunner 570 features a bright OLED display, skin temperature sensors, and a built-in speaker and microphone for taking calls. It also offers multiband GPS, personalized training plans, and up to 11 days of battery life. Where to Buy: $549.99 $449.99 at Amazon $549.99 $449.99 at Best Buy $550 $449.99 at REI Garmin Venu 4 Garmin’s Venu 4 is geared toward the average athlete, offering heart rate alerts, detailed sleep insights, guided meditation, and a wheelchair mode. It also introduces caffeine and alcohol tracking, along with Garmin Coach, which tailors workouts to your fitness history, sleep, and recovery. Where to Buy: $549.93 at Amazon $549.99 at Best Buy $550 $449.99 at REI REI , Amazon , and Best Buy are also selling the Garmin Lily 2 Active for $249.99 ($50 off), which is its lowest price to date. The stylish smartwatch is a great budget-friendly Garmin, especially for people with smaller wrists. Like the standard Lily 2, it offers basic fitness tracking, notifications, and up to five days of battery life; however, the so-called “Active” model adds a physical button, built-in GPS, and support for more sports tracking. Read our Lily 2 review . The Garmin Vivoactive 6 has returned to its all-time low of $249.99 ($50 off) at Amazon , Walmart , and REI . The fitness watch offers up to 11 days of battery life and tracks a range of workouts, including walking, running, cycling, HIIT, golf, and more. It also provides extensive health monitoring, including wrist-based heart rate detection, menstrual cycle and pregnancy tracking, and a customizable morning report that summarizes helpful health-related info. However, it lacks ECG compatibility, though it does have a slightly slimmer profile than its predecessor. Garmin Fenix 8 The Garmin Fenix 8 is a premium multisport watch that features a speaker, mic, and on-device assistant for calls, timers, and voice commands. It also offers elite battery life, dual-frequency GPS, and robust sensors. Read our review . Where to Buy: $999.99 $749.99 at Amazon (43mm) $1099.99 $749.99 at Walmart (47mm) $1099.99 $849.99 at REI (47mm) The Wahoo Kickr V6 Smart Trainer is on sale at REI for $679.99 ($170 off). Like the more affordable Kickr Core 2 we covered in July , the Kickr V6 turns your existing bike into an indoor exercise bike, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity for pairing with apps like Zwift . However, the higher-end trainer offers up to 2,200W of resistance and can replicate inclines of up to 20 percent, compared to the Core 2’s 1,800W and 16 percent. It also provides more accurate power measurements and is designed so that indoor rides feel more natural. Phone accessories and entertainment EcoFlow Rapid Magnetic Power Bank EcoFlow’s Rapid Magnetic Power Bank is a 10,000mAh Qi2 battery that can snap to the back of your device if you’re using a newer iPhone or select Android devices, thus supplying it with up to 15W of power. It also includes a built-in USB-C cable that can provide up to 65W of power to larger devices, including a 13-inch MacBook Air. Where to Buy: $90 $66.93 at REI If you own an older iPhone with a Lightning port, you can grab InfinityLab’s InstantGo 10,000 Power Bank   for  $41.93 (about $28 off) at REI . The portable battery features a 10,000mAh capacity and a built-in Lightning cable, making it a solid all-in-one option for days when you won’t be near an outlet. It also supports passthrough charging, so you can charge your phone and the power bank at the same time. DJI’s Osmo Mobile 8 is on sale for around $128.99 ($21 off) at REI , Amazon , and Best Buy , which is $10 shy of its best price to date. The smartphone gimbal supports 360-degree horizontal rotation and Apple’s DockKit, which allows the gimbal to track and follow pets and people across a wider range of camera apps. This discounted Advanced Tracking Combo also includes a multifunctional module for tracking people and pets, as well as a built-in tripod and extension rod that make it easier to film yourself without someone behind the camera. Soundcore Liberty 5 The Soundcore Liberty 5 feature adaptive noise cancellation and support for Dolby Audio, along with six swappable tips so you can find the right fit. They also sport an IP55 rating for water and dust resistance and can last up to 48 hours with the included charging case. Where to Buy: $129.99 $89.99 at Amazon $129.99 $89.99 at Walmart $130 $89.99 at REI You can buy Soundcore’s AeroFit 2 for $79.99 ($20 off) at REI , Amazon , and Best Buy , which is $2 shy of their lowest price to date. Their open-ear design lets you listen to music while staying vigilant in your surroundings; they also feature adjustable ear hooks for a secure fit, IP55 water and dust resistance, and up to 42 hours of battery life with the included charging case. Anker Nebula P1 projector Anker’s Nebula P1 is a portable 1080p projector with built-in Google TV and two detachable Bluetooth speakers that deliver better sound than many all-in-one portable projectors. It offers 650 ANSI lumens of brightness and can project images up to 180 inches, while the speakers last up to 20 hours on a charge. Where to Buy: $799 $599.99 at Amazon $799 $599 at Soundcore $799 $699.99 at REI Communication and safety gear Garmin InReach Mini 3 Plus The Mini 3 Plus is identical to the standard model in that it allows you to stay connected while off the grid; however, it also features an audible siren and the ability to send photos and voice messages, in addition to standard texts. Where to Buy: $499.99 $399.99 at Amazon $499.99 $399.99 at REI $499.99 $399.99 at Garmin Garmin’s base InReach Mini 3 is available from REI , Amazon , and Garmin for around $349 ($100 off), nearly matching its lowest price to date. Like the Mini 2, the rugged, palm-sized satellite communicator lets you send texts, share your location, check the weather, and trigger SOS alerts when you’re off the grid, all while offering battery life that can outlast your average smartphone. Unlike the prior version, though, it features a color touchscreen, which makes it easier to navigate menus and bang out messages.
